title: B-ROLL: Low Pressure, Heavy Lifting – CDDAR
description:
New Jersey Air National Guard maintainers from the 177th Fighter Wing’s
Crash Damaged Disabled Recovery  (CDDAR) team trained at the Naval Air Station Wildwood Aviation Museum in Cape May, N.J. May 22, 2016.
A primary objective of the CDDAR program is to return any runways
involved in a mishap to operational status as soon as practical. Unit members with unique fields of expertise teamed up to complete annual training using compressors, gauged manifolds, hoses and pneumatic bags to simulate lifting an F-16D Fighting Falcon with a failed landing gear.
